text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and the Trainer come to
watch 
the Japan Derby along with Twin Turbo and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result was a victory for Tokai Teio. 
Having achieved the glorious feat of an 
undefeated Double Crown,
it was discovered 
after the race that she had suffered a 
bone fracture.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public and Twin Turbo's circle were 
crushed by the news. Yet Tokai Teio 
herself smiled and declared that she
would 
make her comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The topic of Tokai Teio also came up 
between Ikuno Dictus and Mejiro McQueen. 
The two of them prayed for Tokai Teio's 
swift recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And when she made her return, she wished 
from the bottom of her heart to face
Tokai 
Teio and her brilliant, genius running.
